facts.fact: 她已在心里排练冠夫姓：Mrs Cassie Munro 听起来刚刚好。
facts.anchor: Mrs Cassie Munro sounds perfect for me.

facts.fact: 情报更新：他 34 岁、不（能？）开车——她醉得分不清是哪个。
facts.anchor: ageing like a fine wine at thirty-four, doesn’t, or can’t, drive

facts.fact: 两人原来住得只差半小时脚程——命定感又添一枚。
facts.anchor: As it transpires, we’ve been living quite close to each other all this time.

facts.fact: 她的担保：他是个好灵魂，绝不会拿她说过的话对付她。
facts.anchor: Luckily, I just know Finlay is a good soul. He would never use anything I’ve done or said against me

facts.fact: 她感觉半个灵魂终于找到另一半——从没人这样努力去懂她。
facts.anchor: It really does feel like two halves of one soul are finally uniting because I’ve never had someone put so much effort into understanding me.

facts.fact: 出租车队伍里他提议走去他家——「说实话，我还不想结束今晚」。
facts.anchor: I’ll be completely honest with you…I don’t want to end the night yet.’

facts.fact: 走去他家的路上她已全盘交代：年龄、履历、没朋友、与疏远的父母的关系。
facts.anchor: I realise I’ve confessed my age, my career history, my lack of friends, and my relationship with my estranged parents.

facts.fact: 她踮脚想吻，他像皮筋一样弹开——只剩火辣辣的刺痛；随后他把她抱起抵门深吻。
facts.anchor: but as soon as I get on my tiptoes, he snaps back like an elastic band, pinging away from me, leaving behind nothing but the sharp sting.

facts.fact: 他的判词：我从没有过这种感觉——你完美，Cassie，完美。
facts.anchor: ‘I’ve never felt this way before. You’re perfect, Cassie. Just perfect.’
